page.title: Statistics
page.description: Visualize your journaling patterns and review AI activity across your entries.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: See how your logged emotions trend over time, then ask AI to surface recurring themes and mood drivers for the period.
insights.emotion_trend_empty_hint: Tag entries with an emotion to see trends here.
insights.ai_themes_description: On-demand analysis of recurring themes and likely mood drivers. Uses entry text from the selected period.
insights.disabled_hint: Enable “Theme insights” in Settings → AI to generate themes.
insights.needs_provider_hint: Configure a generation provider in Settings → AI first.
insights.needs_privacy_hint: Accept the AI privacy notice in Settings → AI first.

location_heatmap.title: Location Heatmap
location_heatmap.empty: No geotagged entries yet — add a location in the toolbar to see this map.
location_heatmap.mapkit_notice: The heatmap needs the Offline or MapTiler map source. Apple Maps cannot show a heatmap overlay yet.

empty.no_data_hint: Write a few entries to see your stats here.

modal.title: Export statistics
modal.png_hint: PNG snapshots are only available when the Charts section is selected.
modal.png_needs_charts: PNG snapshots require the Charts section to be selected.
modal.png_needs_visible: Open the Charts tab first — PNG captures the rendered chart SVGs.

error.empty: Nothing to export for the chosen format and sections yet.
